integrity: The general formula follows from the negative-curve classification and Schur complement; exhaustive exact small-rank computations are corroboration, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Theorem for complex blow-ups of the positive section with \(e\ge2\) and \(n-e\ge2\); counts supports, not volumes. Priority may be affected by inaccessible full text of the 2023 ruled-surface paper.
title: Zariski-chamber support polynomials on section blow-ups of Hirzebruch surfaces
